connectionParameters.label: API Key
connectionParameters.name: api_key
connectionParameters.desc: Pulsedive API key (passed as query parameter)

desc: Pulsedive integration for cyber threat intelligence enrichment. Supports enriching IPs, domains, URLs, and file hashes, plus searching indicators and threats using the Pulsedive REST API.

functions.label: Test Connectivity
functions.name: test_connectivity
functions.desc: Validate the API key and connectivity to Pulsedive

functions.label: Get Indicator Details
functions.name: get_indicator_details
functions.desc: Retrieve full threat intelligence details for any indicator (IP, domain, URL, or hash)

inParameters.label: Indicator
inParameters.name: indicator
inParameters.desc: The indicator value to look up (IP, domain, URL, or hash)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Indicator details including risk, threats, and feeds

functions.label: Enrich IP
functions.name: enrich_ip
functions.desc: Enrich an IP address with Pulsedive threat intelligence

inParameters.label: IP Address
inParameters.name: ip
inParameters.desc: IPv4 or IPv6 address to enrich

functions.label: Enrich Domain
functions.name: enrich_domain
functions.desc: Enrich a domain name with Pulsedive threat intelligence

functions.label: Enrich URL
functions.name: enrich_url
functions.desc: Enrich a URL with Pulsedive threat intelligence

inParameters.label: URL
inParameters.name: url
inParameters.desc: Full URL to enrich (must start with http:// or https://)

functions.label: Enrich Hash
functions.name: enrich_hash
functions.desc: Enrich a file hash (MD5, SHA1, or SHA256) with Pulsedive threat intelligence

inParameters.label: Hash
inParameters.name: hash
inParameters.desc: File hash to enrich (MD5: 32 chars, SHA1: 40 chars, SHA256: 64 chars)

functions.label: Search Indicators
functions.name: search_indicators
functions.desc: Search Pulsedive for indicators matching a query with optional type and risk filters

inParameters.label: Indicator Type
inParameters.name: indicator_type
inParameters.desc: Filter by indicator type (ip, domain, url, hash)

inParameters.label: Risk Level
inParameters.name: risk
inParameters.desc: Filter by risk level (none, low, medium, high, critical, unknown)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of matching indicators with total count

functions.label: Search Threats
functions.name: search_threats
functions.desc: Search Pulsedive for threat entries matching a query

inParameters.label: Query
inParameters.name: query
inParameters.desc: Threat name or keyword to search

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of matching threats with total count
